identity: Simply supported beam-and-slab road bridge 'near Vransko', 5 beams, 26 m total / 24.8 m between bearings, 12 m wide, no skew; SiWIM NOR test site, 25 Sep-21 Nov 2006 (58 days), 147,524 vehicles (~74,000 five-axle articulated).
conflicts: Record says it carries the A1 motorway and is a 'motorway crossing in the Savinja valley'; the cited UCD paper only says 'a bridge near Vransko in Slovenia' and names no road or obstacle. Unsourced.
Paper reports two first natural frequencies (4.33 Hz simulated, 5.32 Hz measured first longitudinal mode); not in record, just a caveat if used.

Record history says 'additional upstream and downstream gauges for axle detection'; paper says one upstream and one downstream gauge per instrumented lane in a NOR system (no axle detectors on the pavement). Wording 'axle detection' is an interpretation.

instruments.value: 10 strain sensors at midspan soffit (2 per beam) + 1 upstream and 1 downstream gauge per instrumented lane; SiWIM Nothing-On-the-Road

notes: No source found giving the bridge's road, crossing or coordinates; the 'locality' point stays a Vransko settlement placeholder. The record's A1 claim needs a source (e.g., DARS bridge register or a Žnidarič/ZAG paper naming the structure) before publishing. Search budget ran out before more sources could be tried.

identity: Slano blato landslide/earthflow on the Grajšček stream below Čaven, above Lokavec (Ajdovščina); Triassic limestone over Eocene flysch (Trnovo overthrust).

Main activation date: NHESS 2005 says 19 November 2000; Wikipedia says November 2000. Secondary flows: NHESS says 20 Mar-25 Apr 2001 advance and October 2001 mudflows; record/Wikipedia say September 2001.
Removed volume: Wikipedia 230,000 m3, NHESS ~200,000 m3 (by end 2004).

elevation_m.value: 270-640 a.s.l.; main scarp ~640; initiation ~570; Dec 2000 front ~380

event_dates.value: 1786 (Hacquet); 20 Oct 1885; 19 Nov 2000 main triggering; 20 Mar-25 Apr 2001; Oct 2001 mudflows
